title: Employee Task Management System
summary: Full-stack web application orchestrating multi-departmental task assignment, state lifecycle tracking, and role-based access control with normalized PostgreSQL schema.
problem_statement: Manual tracking of inter-departmental task assignments led to lost state updates and uncoordinated work handoffs. A centralized, deterministic access-controlled API was required.
architecture_overview: Structured under Django's Model-View-Controller paradigm with Django REST Framework serialization layers. Implemented 12 REST API endpoints handling authentication, task creation, status transitions, and managerial reporting.
database_design: Normalized relational schema in PostgreSQL enforcing foreign key constraints between Employee, Department, Task, and TaskAuditLog tables. Role-based query filtering prevents unauthorized cross-department data exposure.
